title: mac-lte: Fix memory access in LONG_BSR_LCID
description:
Before this change, when reaching LCID Group 2 in LONG_BSR_LCID parsing,
the call to `proto_tree_add_item_ret_uint` with `(guint32*)&buffer_size[2]`
would access memory beyond the array since it the array contains 4 elements
of type guin8. The invalid access sometimes created an unexpected write
to the `lcids` array, changing the LCID and causing a wrong dissection
of the matching body.

notes.body:
Given that, with this change, `buffer_size[]` is an array of `guint32`, you can replace all occurrences of `(guint32*)&buffer_size[n]`, for all values of `n`, with just `&buffer_size[n]`.

(The casts appear to be a way of telling the compiler to shut up about the problems it's pointing out with the previous code; the best way to get it to stop complaining about the problems is to *fix the problems*, as your change does.)
